references.text: The same principle of helping a poor brother and not closing one's hand to him, but opening it willingly for the needy.
The commandment to open one's hand to the poor and needy brother in the land.
Continuation of the same context on how to treat a brother who has become poor.
The commandment to treat foreigners and residents with love, as the verse mentions גֵּר וְתוֹשָׁב (foreigner and resident).
God loves the foreigner and gives him food and clothing, and Israel must also love the foreigner.
Blessing upon the one who cares for the weak and poor.
The one who despises their neighbor sins, but blessed is the one who shows mercy to the poor.
A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born to help in trouble.
If anyone has material possessions and sees a brother or sister in need but closes their heart against them, how can God's love be in them?
Faith without works is dead - one must help brothers and sisters who lack food and clothing.
Exhortation to do good to everyone, especially to those of the faith.
